name: Armoury
author: gdeyoung
description: ASUS laptop control centre: tabbed panel (Overview / Fan / Battery / Advanced) with CPU+GPU temp gauges, fan-curve editor on supported machines (capability-gated), battery health & wear, charge care mode, GPU mode switching on dGPU machines, charge-limit slider, fan, platform profile, pending-reboot flag, and a read-only firmware-attribute browser

barWidget.description: ASUS temps, fan, battery care mode, firmware attributes
